support_story_1_headline: Xa wali rabae siga yare, ɲama xa yare masigE.
support_story_1_lead: Wo xa wo xa masini makanta masinie ma naxan mu xui ra bama a nun masini kanaxie.
support_story_1_body: Innioasis tEmui birin a firmware nEnEe ra mini ma nE alo Y1 (naxan na 6.0, 7.0, a nun 8.0) naxan masini fori kana ma. Naxan man ɲaaxu, e xa yi luti yusife mu lanma a xa findi marasi yo ra, a man mu lanma a xa so firmware forie kui alako a xa gbilen a xa wali ma. Updater CE nun Community Firmware project na fe birin tongo ma: moxo na ROM fori birin ragatama, moxo wo xa hardware revision mato ma nE a yEtE ra, moxo wo xa player ra tima a fangni ra.
support_story_1_item_1: Mixi faxaxie ratangafe: Safe matofe a ma senxi nE a fe nEnEe mu fama hardware fori kana de.
support_story_1_item_2: Archived Stock ROMs: Complete collection of original factory firmwares Innioasis deleted.
support_story_1_item_3: Native Cross-Platform: Full flashing tools for macOS, Linux, and Windows alike.
support_story_1_item_4: Hardware Intelligence: Automatic board detection ala ko wo xa nO package fangni sOtOde tEmui birin.
support_story_2_headline: Google Drive kanaxi yo mu na. Xaxili yo mu na. Firmware nan walima.
support_story_2_lead: A ma fura, a kolon xi nE a wo nOma wo xaxili tide naxan na.
support_story_2_body: Innioasis logiciel officiel fenfe a masenxi nE a wo lan ma wo xa forum fen Google Drive links forie ma, Baidu cloud shares faxaxie, a nun zip file gundoe naxan mu na flashing tools ra. Moxo bara resE nde yailan naxan lanlanteya sOtOxi, a nun SHA-256 tinxin gni, a nun manE gnErE, a nun installation kirayae. Wo xa kObiri naxan fixi a yi ra bama nE a nun wo xa a ragata waxati 24 lOxE keren, lOxE tongo saxan a nun suli suli gnE keren kui.
support_story_2_item_1: Direct High-Speed ​​CDN: Fast, direct downloads with no download limits or dead links.
support_story_2_item_2: Notifications de l'update: Wo xa a kolon waxati naxan ma mixi nEnEe xa fe ra bama xa na mu a ra e xa yalan.
support_story_2_item_3: Guided Step-by-Step Installs: Clear visual prompts guide you through every pressing button.
support_story_2_item_4: Xui wuyaxi: a birin na AngilE, Sinuwa, Alman, Espanyol, Fransi a nun Japon xui nan kui.
support_story_3_headline: Wo xa Innioasis player sEmbE birin rabi.
support_story_3_lead: Rockbox rafafe, operating system lanma, a nun audiophile xa xOrOxOE.
support_story_3_body: Stock factory logiciel gbansan nan a ra naxan wo xa Y1 xa na mu Y2 hardware nO ma naxan nabade. Moxo xa mixie bara Rockbox rafa, operating system lanma, audiophile codec playback, a nun themes keren keren ma. Moukha se mOdEli sarama moxo yEtE bE ala ko moxo xa a ma to, a xa gbilen a ra, a nun a xa installation birin mato. Updater CE ma sEmbE sofe yi tEsitE ma a nun a firmware yalan fe ma fura.
support_story_3_item_1: One-Click Rockbox: Audiophile playback and custom themes installed in seconds.
support_story_3_item_2: Community Firmware: batErie xunmasafe, UI fiixE, a nun audio codec malife.
support_story_3_item_3: Active Hardware Lab: moxo na masini yati nan ma tofe beenun moxo xa build yo ramini.
support_story_3_item_4: Zero Bloatware: 100% free, logiciel privacy-first with no ads or tracking.
support_story_4_headline: Wo moxo mali moxo xa fe raba naxan Innioasis mu a ra bama.
support_story_4_lead: Firmware ragatafe naxan fatanxi ɲama ra naxan wo xa masinee ratangama yire makuye.
support_story_4_body: Xa hardware walide nde na siga a xa gadget gbEtE ma, modele forie na lu ma nE. Innioasis mu Linux mali yo ra bama, a mu changelogs ra bama, a man mu kira mafuren ma naxan nOma gbilen de a ra xa a sa li a bara kana. Updater CE na na barima mixi naxee wama a xa wali rafan e ma e mu lan e xa kOnOni fangni woli. 100% ɲama xa mali nan a ra naxan yi walise rabixi birin bE.
support_story_4_item_1: Rescue & Unbrick: Proven recovery flows hali masine tondixi a xa boote.
support_story_4_item_2: Linux First-Class Support: Fully supported MediaTek flashing on Linux distros.
support_story_4_item_3: Transparent Changelogs: Detailed release notes ala ko wo xa a kolon naxan masarama.
support_story_4_item_4: 100% Community Funded: Kafe birin na buki ragatade rabi ma a nun a mu sare fima birin bE.
